messages:
sylvia (sec-eng): Auditor needs a packaged RBAC change + auth logs bundle, KMS-wrapped, with checksums and a control map. Can we hand off with presigned links rather than bucket creds?
omar (infra): Yes. We'll create a zip, KMS-encrypt, upload, add head-object JSON, and generate presigned URLs. Recommend 72h expiry. Will include sha256 for each file.
auditor_kim: 72h works. Need sha256 for each object, the KMS key ARN, a CSV mapping each artifact to SOC2/ISO controls, and brief redaction notes. Also require a short README describing how the bundle was produced.
ravi (compliance): Include retention metadata (default 90 days), object tags (evidence=true, audit_period=Q1-2026), and the exact CLI command used to generate the bundle for reproducibility.
packager-bot: upload started -> s3://redwood-evidence/packets/rbac-change-2026-02-17.zip
packager-bot: upload complete -> s3://redwood-evidence/packets/rbac-change-2026-02-17.zip
omar (infra): Bundle sha256: a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2 (full hash in manifest). KMS key ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd1234-ef56-7890-abcd-ef1234567890. Head-object JSON saved as /meta/head-object.json (SSEKMSKeyId present).
sylvia (sec-eng): Manifest CSV sample header and one line (we'll attach full CSV): filename,s3_uri,sha256,kms_key_arn,created_by,created_at,control_refs,redaction_notes
rbac-change-2026-02-17.zip,s3://redwood-evidence/packets/rbac-change-2026-02-17.zip,a1b2c3...,arn:aws:kms:.../abcd1234,sylvia@redwood.com,2026-02-17T12:05:00Z,SOC2-CC6.1|ISO27001-A.9.4,none
packager-bot: presigned URL generated (72h) and DMed to auditor_kim; object tags & lifecycle set.
auditor_kim: Received DM, starting verification of sha256 and head-object JSON. Will post acceptance or short follow-up. Thanks all.
